'''Tom Lischke''' is a Decipher game designer. He was lead game designer of the [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] (2001) and later designed for ''The Lord of the Rings'' TCG.<ref name="jkrules" /><ref name="tor-chat">[http://archives.theonering.net/events/logs/201001.html TheOneRing Chat &mdash; Tom Lischke and Chuck Kallenbach], 20 October 2001 (archives)</ref> He won the [[1996 Bespin Regionals (Collinsville)]].<ref name="dec96" />

== Star Wars CCG ==

Lischke appeared with [[Jerry Darcy]] and [[Chuck Kallenbach]] on [[Radio Free Decipher]] Broadcast 2 (11 December 1998), the episode that billed Darcy as Star Wars CCG Lead Game Designer.<ref name="rfd">[https://wiki.lotrtcgpc.net/wiki/Radio_Free_Decipher Radio Free Decipher episode index], LOTR-TCG PC wiki</ref><ref name="rfd2">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w2Ao759YJlk RFD Broadcast 2], YouTube <code>w2Ao759YJlk</code> (Player's Council upload)</ref> Broadcast 51 (22 September 2000) featured him on the [[Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]] product.<ref name="rfd51">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2tQmFqhsx74 RFD Broadcast 51 &mdash; Tom Lischke (Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck)], YouTube <code>2tQmFqhsx74</code></ref> He held a Star Wars CCG question-and-answer session at [[DecipherCon 2000]] on 7 October 2000.<ref name="dcon2000-sem">[https://web.archive.org/web/20061114195529/http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2000/seminars/ DecipherCon 2000 seminars], Decipher (Wayback 14 November 2006)</ref> The card [[Lieutenant Sheckil]] is an anagram of his name.<ref name="ana">[https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/anagrams.html Anagramed Decipherians]</ref>

== Jedi Knights / LOTR / WARS ==

Lischke discussed ''Jedi Knights'' and LOTR TCG design on Radio Free Decipher, and joined Kallenbach in a 2001 TheOneRing chat as LOTR designers.<ref name="rfd" /><ref name="tor-chat" /><ref name="tor-lotr">[https://www.theonering.net/torwp/2002/02/14/26785-decipher-talks-lotr/ Decipher Talks LOTR], TheOneRing.net, 14 February 2002</ref> In 2004 Decipher WARS Radio featured him on WARS TCG design.<ref name="wars02">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ikcgtmhuhbc WARS Radio 02 &mdash; Tom Lischke], YouTube <code>Ikcgtmhuhbc</code></ref>

== Jedi Knights TCG ==
Lischke was lead game designer of the [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] (2001). In early 2001 he was spearheading the design of both the Star Wars CCG and Jedi Knights.<ref name="jkrules">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt ''Jedi Knights'' Trading Card Game rulebook (credits)], Decipher (2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010820125115/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="jkpersonae">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/designdiary/personae.html Design Diary: Dramatis personae], decipher.com (2000–2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010224092942/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/designdiary/personae.html Internet Archive]</ref>
